en: Sepia-toned street scene in a European city showing an early electric or tramcar pulling several small freight wagons along a narrow street lined with multi-story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk. Hanging business signs are visible on the left side of the street, and a sign above a doorway on the right appears to read something like "JACK." Other wall signs can be seen but are not clearly legible.
